title: Entropic Propagation and Generation of Chaos for McKean-Vlasov Diffusions with Polynomial Growth
summary: We study time-uniform propagation and generation of chaos for a class of McKean-Vlasov equations with polynomial growth potentials. Using an entropy dissipation method based on time-uniform logarithmic Sobolev inequalities, we derive uniform-in-time bounds depending on the regularity of the potentials and the assumptions on the initial conditions.
